basic_profile.bio: Avid manga and anime enthusiast hailing from Portland, Oregon. I've been a Redditor for nearly a decade, sharing my love for storytelling through various mediums. When I'm not discussing the latest manga releases, you can find me jamming out to Weezer or chilling to C418's ambient tracks. As a software developer, my schedule is flexible, allowing me to be online mostly during late evenings and weekends. Currently single, I enjoy exploring the latest in gaming and tech. Dislikes include spoilers and toxic fandoms.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and a lifelong passion for anime and manga, I have a well-rounded knowledge of digital media and storytelling. My expertise stems from years of self-teaching and community engagement, often participating in fan discussions and content creation.
